tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.44;
son of: Abdi (H5660);
father of: Jeduthun (H3038); also called Kushaiah at 1Ch.15.17;
Another name of qi.shi (קִישִׁי "Kishi" H7029)
§ Kushaiah = "bow of Jehovah"
1) father of Ethan the Merarite
1a) same as 'Kish' or 'Kishi'

strongs_1890.derivation: from the passive participle of H6983 (קוֹשׁ) and H3050 (יָהּ); entrapped of Jah;
